title: Botanical fashion editorial

reverse_engineered_prompt: Create a refined fashion editorial portrait of a young adult model in a warm botanical studio. Frame the subject from the chest up, positioned slightly right of center, with expressive natural posing and contemporary understated styling. Surround the portrait with layered green leaves and soft organic shapes. Use warm directional afternoon light, gentle highlights on the face, rich forest-green and muted amber tones, subtle film grain, tactile fabric detail, and a sophisticated magazine-editorial composition. Keep the background softly atmospheric and the subject clearly separated. No text, logos, watermark, or extra fingers. 4:3 landscape composition.
